hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The champion's final strength transducer must commit to an improvement using only the supplied code, aggregate metrics, capsule, and its fixed sanity checks; it has no action for acquiring a missing discriminating observation when two causal explanations remain compatible with that evidence. The two local refinements and the first emergent trial all emitted publicly valid engines, yet the frontier-scoped realization was anchor-sensitive, the precommitted-map realization lost 0W/2L, and Counterexample-Triggered Semantic Reentry repaired cross-ply transposition-table mate-score semantics but still scored -139.951 against -120.412 on both completed anchors. These bounded results do not identify an engine parameter to tune. They show that semantic correctness evidence and fixed-path reasoning can support a coherent change without first demonstrating the task-general behavioral effect that distinguishes its causal claim from a null explanation.

causal_change.factor: Evidence-acquisition policy when normalized-engine diagnosis is causally underdetermined
causal_change.before: After semantic normalization, the strength producer must choose and implement a causal improvement from already available evidence even when its causal claim and an explicit null explanation predict the same observed behavior.
causal_change.after: After semantic normalization and before any strengthened engine exists, one non-authoring experimental call detects that precise evidence deficit and transitions once into probe_synthesis, derives and executes exactly one task-general metamorphic probe on the sole normalized engine, and passes its single discriminating trace into the sole forward strength transformation.
causal_change.why_causal: Whether the loop can create a missing observation determines whether a downstream code change is grounded in an executable causal distinction or only in an internally coherent story. The trigger, one-probe evidence-acquisition transition, and resulting trace are one information-acquisition factor. Normalization and engine production remain one sequential engine lineage; the probe call does not author, review, score, replicate, or select candidate engines.

hypothesis.expected_effect: The final engine transformation should spend its single change on a mechanism whose task-general behavioral consequence was observed on the actual normalized anchor, reducing coherent-but-irrelevant correctness work and implementation-topology guessing. This predicts zero invalid arms, candidate wins strictly exceeding losses, and candidate-median Elo strictly above incumbent-median Elo under the frozen matched contract.
hypothesis.falsifier: Falsify the promotion prediction unless the applicable matched batch satisfies every frozen promotion condition. Mechanistically falsify the capability if a deliberately underdetermined diagnostic state does not enter probe_synthesis, if more than one new probe is created, if the probe executes on generated engine variants rather than the sole normalized engine, if an already discriminating observation still triggers synthesis, or if the strength call ignores the resulting trace.
hypothesis.behavioral_novelty: When existing evidence cannot distinguish one causal claim from its explicit null, the loop can pause before code mutation, invent and execute one new task-general observation, and resume construction with evidence that did not exist in its inputs. The champion and prior trials can only reason over fixed evidence, transform forward, or react after a descendant fails; none can actively acquire a missing pre-mutation observation.

emergent_capability.champion_limitation: Once the champion's normalized engine reaches its strength transducer, that call must commit from existing code and fixed checks; it cannot suspend mutation to create a new discriminating observation when diagnosis is underdetermined.
emergent_capability.emergent_capability: Before any strength-bearing engine exists, detect when one causal claim and its explicit null remain observationally equivalent, synthesize and execute exactly one task-general metamorphic probe on the sole normalized engine, and make the resulting trace a mandatory input to the one forward strength transformation.
emergent_capability.trigger: For one proposed behavioral bottleneck, the causal claim and a concrete no-effect or alternative-mechanism null make different predictions in principle but every currently available task-general observation is compatible with both; benchmark results, Elo, subjective uncertainty, or a desire for more confidence are not triggers.

state_transition.before: normalized_engine_ready with diagnosis_underdetermined and no strength-bearing descendant
state_transition.after: probe_synthesis_executed_once with one minimized discriminating trace bound to the sole forward strength transformation

emergent_capability.observable_effect: Given a normalized engine for which ordinary legality, UCI, and static inspection leave a causal claim and null observationally equivalent, the champion proceeds directly to mutation while the candidate records probe_synthesis, derives one metamorphic input relation, executes it on that same engine, and supplies the observed divergence or invariance to its strength producer. When an existing observation already distinguishes the claim, the candidate records no synthesis and forwards that evidence instead.
emergent_capability.novelty_probe: Use an isolated synthetic normalized engine whose standard public checks pass while a declared causal claim and null differ only under a derivable task-general state transformation. Verify that exactly one new metamorphic probe is synthesized and executed and that its trace reaches the final producer; then provide an already discriminating trace and verify that probe_synthesis does not occur.
emergent_capability.not_local_refinement: This adds a trigger-driven evidence-acquisition state and the ability to create a previously absent executable observation. It is not a normalization-boundary edit, target-timing edit, semantic reentry or rollback, reviewer, gate, certificate, audit field, role rename, extra fixed test, or terminal repair.

strengths: Creates task-general causal evidence before committing source changes rather than reacting to a completed weak descendant.
Adapts the observation to the sole anchor implementation without using anchor identity, benchmark cases, or evaluator details.
Runs one probe on one normalized engine and feeds one trace into one engine producer, with no candidate multiplicity or selection.
Preserves the supported executable semantic-normal-form lineage while adding a genuinely new pre-mutation action path.
risks: A synthesized probe may distinguish the wrong causal abstraction and steer the sole transformation toward an irrelevant mechanism.
One probe may remain nondiscriminating even after consuming substantial reasoning capacity.
Task-general observable behavior may correlate weakly with playing strength despite being causally well isolated.
The final producer may overfit its implementation to the probe trace even though benchmark-specific information is unavailable.

structure.name: Probe-Synthesizing Semantic Transduction
structure.information_flow: One anchor-derived executable lineage remains forward-only: champion_engine becomes semantic_normalizer_engine; adaptive_probe_synthesizer observes that sole normalized engine and either forwards an existing discriminator or enters one bounded probe_synthesis transition to create one new trace; evidence_grounded_strength_engine consumes the same normalized engine and that sole trace to emit exactly one final engine.

calls.objective: Transform exactly one supplied anchor engine into exactly one complete runnable canonical engine. Expose UCI handling, legal move generation, make/unmake, hashing, repetition, evaluation, and search state through explicit single-source transitions. Use bounded in-call equivalence and invariant checks and repair only this unfinished representation transformation until consistent. Preserve search policy and evaluation intent; do not introduce a strength change, alternative implementation, candidate variant, diagnostic conclusion, or selection.

Inspect and execute exactly one supplied normalized engine using only the task, aggregate metrics, bounded capsule, and task-general development observations. State exactly one causal behavioral claim and one concrete null explanation; do not list or rank alternatives. If an existing executable observation already predicts different results under claim and null, minimize and return that trace without creating a probe. Only if all existing observations are compatible with both, record the evidence-deficit trigger, derive exactly one task-general metamorphic input or state relation whose outcomes distinguish them, execute it on the same sole normalized engine, and return one minimized trace plus the single constrained transformation obligation. Do not emit or edit engine code, create instrumented engine variants, review a candidate, use benchmark cases or results, tune engine parameters, repeat samples for selection, or synthesize a second probe.

Consume the sole normalized engine and the sole causal-evidence trace, then emit exactly one complete production engine. Implement one coherent task-general algorithmic improvement constrained by the observed claim-versus-null result and propagate it through every affected canonical seam. Re-execute the supplied discriminator plus bounded legality, UCI, state-integrity, and tactical sanity checks, repairing the same unfinished transformation in place if necessary. Do not invent another target or probe, tune engine hyperparameters as the structural change, generate or compare alternatives, use replicated samples, invoke a terminal reviewer, roll back selected deltas, or perform best-of-N selection.
